capabilities: Highlight the folder container of the active note
Autoscroll the file explorer to the active note
Auto-collapse all folders except the active path
extras: Requires enabling the built-in 'auto-reveal current file' setting in the file explorer for the plugin to function.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer gives no visual indication of which folder contains the currently active note, making it hard to locate in large vaults.
summary: Visual aid that highlights the folder containing the active note in the file explorer, with customizable colors, autoscroll, and auto-collapse.
